e: Israel announces that it prevented an attempt to transfer munitions from Jordan to Israel with a drone.
An ammonia gas leak at an industrial facility in Aqaba injures 14 people.
A Fairchild Republic A-10 Thunderbolt II and approximately eight F-15s are damaged in an Iranian strike on Muwaffaq Salti Air Base.
The Aqaba Marine Reserve is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
The United States imposes a 10% tariff on Jordan, citing the presence of alleged forced labour in the supply chain.
The US announces a trade agreement with Jordan.
One person is killed while eight others are injured in a crowd crush at a gathering to view a FIFA World Cup match in Amman.
The Jordanian Armed Forces intercept an Iranian missile attack on Azraq.
The Jordanian Armed Forces intercept two missiles and two drones from Iran.
Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirms the deployment of interceptor drones and specialists to help protect U.S. military bases in Jordan amid the 2026 Iran war.
In retaliation for the 2026 Israeli–United States strikes on Iran, Iran launches missiles at surrounding countries, including Jordan.
The United States designates the Jordanian chapter of the Muslim Brotherhood as a terrorist organization, citing its support for Hamas.
